Vivek / Karthik — thanks for the tag. Per Redwood standard MSA & Order Form requirements (applies to this deal unless legal ops agrees an exception):

- Commercial General Liability: $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate
- Professional Liability (E&O): $2,000,000 per claim / aggregate where available
- Cyber/Technology Liability: $1,000,000
- Additional Insured: ACME ("Acme Corp, its parent and subsidiaries") to be added as Additional Insured on the CGL via ISO CG 20 10 (or equivalent) endorsement.
- Waiver of Subrogation: not required as a default; if Acme needs it we need to review for exposure and get exec approval.

Acceptable evidence: current ACORD 25 Certificate plus the actual Additional Insured endorsement (signed by the insurer). We do not accept an insurer note on the COI alone.

Please request the insurer to provide:
1) ACORD 25 with policy limits, policy number and effective/expiry
2) PDF copy of the Additional Insured endorsement text, and
3) Carrier contact name/email for verification (underwriting contact preferred).

If Acme is providing an endorsement that modifies limits or scope materially, we will need Legal Ops to pre-approve. If you want, I can draft the exact endorsement language Redwood prefers and attach it to the Order Form.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
